title_en: Couplets for Tying the Kanthi (sacred neck-thread)
translit:
Kanthi bandhva mateni sakhi

Kanthi bandi chhodki lije sharan tumhar ||
Das nimit kachhu bhayo tum jano Kirtar ||1||
Kanthi tilak dharke graho Ramkabir adhar ||
Das garibi grahi raho utaro bhavjal par ||2||
Yah bano Radha Krishnako guru krupate deu ||
Dhirajse dhare raho krupa kare Gurudev ||3||
|| Ramkabir ||
translation:
Couplets for the tying of the kanthi (the sacred neck-thread of initiation).

1. With the tying of the kanthi, loosen my bonds and take me into your refuge. The servant is only an instrument; whatever has come to pass, you know it, O Creator.

2. Wearing the kanthi and the tilak (forehead mark), take Ramkabir as your support. Servant, hold to humility and you will cross to the far shore of the ocean of worldly existence.

3. This garb belongs to Radha and Krishna; I give it to you by the grace of the Guru. Keep wearing it with patience, and Gurudev (the divine master) will show his grace.

|| Ramkabir ||
